raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

H100 native block-FP8 MoE with E128/N768 currently uses the generic fallback. Add a measured unified table for Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8, H10080GB, TP1/EP1, top-k8, using the existing first tuning entry and runtime.

**Draft:** target-model performance and the frozen GSM8K screen pass, but the shared filename omits H/top-k and has a known synthetic H4096 hot-route regression. Resolve this shared-key limitation and complete current-head GPU CI/review before promotion. Omni validation is deferred.

[Unified candidate, paired metrics, question outcomes, source fingerprints and reproduction notes](https://gist.github.com/YzXiao101/c45bb0fdefff3c9fa91bab3b31dc16ed). Start with README.md. All ten published files were fetched back and verified byte-for-byte. The complete local archive additionally retains native responses, search failures and dispatch/compiler records; private activation/routing tensors are not published.

## Modifications

- Add one original first-entry JSON under `triton_3_8_0` for H100 HBM3, E128/N768, FP8 W8A8, block128x128.
- Keep 18 M keys and six shared parameters for both GEMMs; no separate `_down` file, TMA, Split-K or runtime/reader changes. M>=193 selects shipping-default mathematical settings under nearest-M lookup.
- Native SHA256: `3e4387d4624a0797d0d9b83d4bfc38ee7e62bbbc2a9d732352e8f438b377d4ef`.

The table was originally generated by `tuning_fused_moe_triton.py`: 18 M values x1280 settings, 23,040 attempts, 22,464 successful and 576 shared-memory resource failures. Recorded real routes are held-out validation inputs, not used to fit route-specific configurations. A later bounded refinement failed its predeclared gates and was rejected as a whole; the delivered original bytes are unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

Measured source `2f6e0ec45dd8f3bbcd28e3ec97ea47aa9b1fc3e0`; Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8@`d206ba732169f29bb77fbf80fc2c4b81d4d30782`; Torch2.14.1+cu130, Triton3.8.0, CUDA13.0. H2048/I768/E128/top8, TP1/EP1. Eight relevant source paths match PR base `a34cba3c62ff9c0a3e89df9bb25943844804c6ba` and upstream main `aa5551d9b6ebe133427a8a0b368c2643f79d5440`; this does not constitute a whole-tree GPU rerun.

- 3,108 numerical/Graph case-records, zero failures: 2,244 component records plus 864 weight/scale-mutation records, each with four checks (3,456 mutation checks). Real checkpoint layers0/24/47 and independent prefill/decode routes; synthetic H1024/H2048/H4096, 69 M values, random/balanced/hot/hot-dispersed routing, two seeds and varying positive block scales.
- FP32 reference with TF32 disabled, atol=rtol=0.05, candidate relative-L2 error <= default*1.10+0.0001. In-place measurements restore inputs; changing-data Graph replay responds and matches eager within each configuration. Four separately captured weight-address groups reduce single-address reuse bias. This is not cross-config bit-exactness or losslessness.
- Full GSM8K1319: A1244/1319 (94.314%), B1248/1319 (94.617%); C-to-W1/W-to-C5. Paired-question bootstrap95% B-A interval [0.0,+0.682335]pp, passing the frozen lower-bound > -0.5pp screen. Native errors0/0, parse failures2/2, cap hits0/0 remain in the denominator. One full A/B run; the interval excludes run-to-run batching variability and does not establish an accuracy improvement.
- The separate initial campaign on `e49e9711317618218289e479660e28cbef555514` used the same candidate bytes: default1246 versus tuned1245/1319; its full A/A scored1245/1246. These are historical variability context, not matched repeats of this later protocol and not pooled/subtracted. The source-pinned outcomes are retained in the evidence bundle.
- 128 common-prefix one-token probes: zero selected input-logprob delta, identical first generated token/text; all128 prefill selections use changed rows. This does not certify all-vocabulary logits or iterative decode-step equality.

**Known shared-key counterexample:** H4096 synthetic hot/hot-dispersed probes have 37 repeated groups below -5% throughput across seeds43/97, 74 records total; worst -6.5528% (about +7.01% MoE latency). Numerical/Graph guards pass. The filename can also alias Qwen3-235B TP2 geometry, inferred from model metadata and sharding; no full 235B model execution is claimed. Broader H/top-k, TP/EP and compiler stacks remain unqualified.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MoE=Triton, dense=DeepGEMM, attention=FA3. Each arm uses one H100. Four matched observations per workload, two per swapped placement; matched same-candidate A/A controls for primary and C1 latency/interactive cells. Equal paired inputs, fixed output lengths/ignoreEOS, reconciled native tokens and a predeclared no-new/changed-cubin acceptance policy. Percentages are medians of paired changes; brackets are observed min/max, not confidence intervals.

| Requested input/output/C/N | QPS change [observed range] | TTFT p50 change | TTFT p99 change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1000/1000/16/128 | +2.79% [2.75,2.86]% | +0.95% | -1.75% |
| 128/512/64/320 | +2.37% [2.30,2.60]% | -1.01% | -2.14% |
| 8192/32/8/64 | +0.65% [0.08,1.42]% | -0.15% | +0.00% |
| 128/1/1/160 | +0.06% [-0.92,0.63]% | +0.00% | +0.37% |
| 1000/1/1/160 | -0.18% [-1.05,1.03]% | +0.10% | +1.11% |
| 128/512/1/16 | +4.99% [4.66,5.14]% | +0.16% | -0.86% |
| natural input10-2824 (median139)/256/16/128 | +2.19% [2.16,2.54]% | +1.67% | +0.44% |

Fixed-length pressure inputs repeat/truncate ShareGPT text; the natural workload uses disjoint original questions and chat templates. Native lengths differ after text decode/re-encode and are retained in the CSV. Primary/decode/interactive/natural gains are positive in all four observations; primary/interactive gains exceed their recorded A/A throughput variation. Prefill/C1 effects are small and variable. Median TTFT/tail changes pass the frozen target screen, individual tails vary, and no universal latency or production-SLO claim is made. A/A is not subtracted from A/B.

These compare tuned versus shipping Triton, not CUTLASS or Omni. Current-head upstream GPU CI, shared-key resolution, independent quality repeats/full-vocabulary checks, and Omni CUTLASS/stock-Triton/tuned-Triton validation are separate remaining gates.

## Checklist

- [x] Changed-JSON pre-commit hooks and staged/unstaged diff checks pass.
- [x] Final PR diff contains only the immutable unified JSON; no kernel/runtime changes.
- [x] Correct candidate-specific performance/quality evidence, negative cases and reproduction limits are provided.
- [ ] Resolve the known shared-key performance limitation before promotion.
- [ ] Complete current-head upstream GPU CI and required maintainer review.
